_howToUpdate: This file drives the /events page. To update: edit the text below and commit. Cards with an "expires" date (YYYY-MM-DD) automatically disappear from the site the day after that date, so old events clean themselves up. Leave "expires" out for evergreen items that should always show. Keep the tone plain and warm, and do not use em-dashes.

recurring.title: Every Sunday at 5:00 PM
recurring.detail: Cleburne Conference Center · 1501 W Henderson St, Cleburne, TX 76033 · Doors open at 4:30 PM · Kids ministry available · All are welcome

cards.title: Belong and Become
cards.body: One session. 90 minutes. Everything you need to know about who we are, what we believe, and how to move from visitor to family. Reserve your seat online in about a minute.

cards.title: Evangelism Class
cards.body: Learn to share your faith with clarity and confidence. A practical class on telling people about Jesus in everyday life. Register online and we will see you there.

cards.title: Formed and Sent
cards.body: Our discipleship track. Walk through who you are in Christ, what you carry, and how to deploy it in every room you walk into. Ask us about the next cohort start date.

cards.title: The Table and Circles
cards.body: Every partner belongs to a Table: a small group around the Word, prayer, and life together, where you are known and cared for. Circles are open to everyone, built around a shared interest or a season of life. Sign up now.

cards.title: Colossians: Rooted / All of Him
cards.body: The supremacy of Christ and what it means to be rooted in Him. We are walking verse by verse through Colossians this season.

cards.title: Philippians
cards.body: Joy that does not depend on circumstances. The mind of Christ. Contentment in every season. Paul wrote it from prison. We preached it for people who walk in victory.

cards.title: Have a question?
cards.body: Text us at (817) 518-4773 or email info@gatheringctx.org. We will get back to you. Doors are always open.
